architecture: Engineered early swing clearance and synchronized Cartesian servo targets with CEM-tuned stride, period and duty, followed by descent-clearance and pending-retarget refinements; original motor caps and joint limits retained

learning.method: Native Sable CEM over three timing parameters of the 20-parameter gait, combined with engineered swing clearance and synchronized Cartesian servo targets

release_checkpoint.selection_method: Retained checkpoint selected after broader validation of post-training engineering refinements
release_checkpoint.selection_reason: Before the engineering refinements, the training-score winner recorded 71/72 certification passes on source 4be084249f34f6933ed38f182ec4eeacfb69d28f648797121ef8c33fd30bab4e. After the descent-clearance and pending-retarget refinements, the retained generation-1 candidate-3 checkpoint passed the full 97-case qualification and at least 17/18 stress cases on final source 25f7b11c6a5c96462bbfe4d75ae189b036d758ae1f4e6f4e3a098756dffa50da.

post_training_refinement.description: When early clearance is enabled, extra baseline lift measures obstacle height above the higher of departure and landing, instead of their mean; a pure descent no longer adds lift as if it were an obstacle above the path.
post_training_refinement.pending_retarget: A valid destination request can wait for a supported starting stance while the previous route continues. Retrying installs the exact requested goal; stop cancels the request, invalid input preserves it, and pending requests cannot report arrival at the old goal. Native qualification requires the pending-request and actual-new-goal checks.
post_training_refinement.pending_lifecycle: The pending deadline triggers a final planning attempt independently of the retry timer, and old-goal holding is disabled while a request is pending. These lifecycle corrections followed the archived pre-lifecycle validation and require fresh final-source qualification.

inherited_cem_history.method: Native Sable cross-entropy optimization of 20 bounded gait and actuator parameters
inherited_cem_history.qualification_note: Cadence conditioning, braking and gameplay lifecycle were refined after optimization and then separately qualified. Planning, sensing and IK are engineered; this is not end-to-end neural RL.

learning.qualification_note: Only stride, period and duty were fine-tuned in 96 native development episodes; the other 17 genome entries remain exact. Descent clearance and pending retargeting were engineered after CEM and qualified on the final source. Training-score selection and the checkpoint released after broader validation are recorded separately. Qualification courses informed checkpoint selection and refinement, so they are not an untouched holdout. This is not end-to-end neural RL.

physics.attitude_assistance: Finite native pitch/roll torque, all translation and yaw free; no vertical support motor or travel teleportation
physics.precise_collision: Disjoint cuboid union of the authored blocky model; independently checked against OBJ occupancy

qualification.comparison_scope: Identical-course full-system comparison across the recorded training/baseline and final sources: original v9 genome with both swing features disabled versus the released generation-1 candidate-3 genome with both enabled and the post-training descent-clearance and pending-retarget refinements. The descent correction applies only when early clearance is enabled and would be inactive under the baseline flags; pending retargeting is separate navigator behavior and the tested source versions remain distinct. This does not isolate individual feature, timing or refinement effects. Time/speed use only pairs where both succeeded; reverse-motion summaries include every pair and observation durations can differ.
qualification.reverse_motion_definition: Opposite-goal motion proxy, sampled after 80 settle ticks, outside navigator back-outs and more than 3 blocks from goal. Kickbacks count entries above 4 blocks/s reverse speed. These are not measured collision impulses.
qualification.scope: 97 native qualification cases plus 18 development stress cases and 90 fresh original-v9 baseline route trials, following 96 three-parameter CEM development episodes. Another 72 certification and 18 stress trials document the training winner before the descent refinement on the training source and informed checkpoint selection and engineering refinement.
qualification.limits: Stress suite is a development benchmark, not unseen validation. No leap, swimming, wall climbing or universal terrain guarantee; loaded bounded-horizon route planning and large physical footprint.

development_history.scope: Optional checkpoint-validation.json history, checked against its raw candidate and report artifacts. Failures and incomplete evaluations are preserved; these are validation trials, not additional CEM episodes or independent release qualification. Final report aliases must not be counted again.

manifest.note: Development checkpoint selection after the descent-clearance refinement. These trials informed selection; they are not an untouched holdout. Counts are per report and must not be added to duplicated final report aliases. A missing report is incomplete/unrun, not a pass. Source hashes distinguish the unformatted preliminary interaction run from the final frozen implementation. Earlier variants and CEM reports remain separately archived.
